result:
Solutions 1 and 3 both claim 30, but I found a valid 31-word code, so 30 cannot be the maximum. I checked Solution 2's code by hand: every pair of words agrees in at most one coordinate. Positions 1–4 of the 25 non-zero-prefix words are pairwise distinct across the five prefix groups, and for each of the six position pairs the projected pairs are all distinct. I did not independently verify Solution 2's claim that 32 is impossible. Its exhaustive search is plausible but unchecked, so 31 is the best-supported answer rather than a proven one.

CHOICE: 2
